title: The Gardens on El Paseo
description: Open-air luxury retail and dining destination in Palm Desert anchoring the El Paseo corridor with the Coachella Valley's only consolidated collection of flagship designer boutiques.
agent_summary: The Gardens on El Paseo is Palm Desert's premier open-air luxury retail and dining destination, housing the valley's only consolidated collection of flagship designer boutiques including Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Bottega Veneta, Tiffany, and Saks Fifth Avenue alongside a five-restaurant dining cluster on the El Paseo corridor.
